name: fieldset
purpose: Enhances a native fieldset that groups related controls (an address, a date of birth, contact preferences) with the AbsoluteUI legend, help text, required marker, and a group-level error. The controls stay in place; the native element provides the group semantics and disabled state.
whenToUse: Several fields answer one question: address, date of birth, contact preferences.
A validation rule that spans fields: 'Enter a street and a city', 'Choose at least one channel'.
whenNotToUse: One control: use Form Field or the control's own label.
A set of checkboxes or radios with one value: use Checkbox Group or Radio Group (they render their own fieldset).
Visual grouping without a shared question: use Card or layout primitives.
responsive: Grid of the legend, help, error, and the page's controls; the controls keep their own layout.
rtl: Logical properties: the error bar sits at the inline start.
theme: Uses the shared field chrome (legend, help, error) with color-text, color-text-muted, and color-error-fg; the invalid state adds a color-error-fg bar at the inline start.
security: Legend, help, and error text are rendered with textContent; never parsed as HTML.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. The fieldset holds no values; its controls do.
limitations: The group error is set by the application (for example from Form validation); Fieldset does not validate its controls.
Native disabled disables native controls inside; AbsoluteUI controls inside keep their own disabled option in sync only through their native elements.
unsupported: Collapsing the group (use Collapsible or Accordion).
antiPatterns: Nesting fieldsets more than one level deep.
Using a fieldset only for a border around unrelated fields.

adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/fieldset: AuiFieldset component (renders the fieldset; children stay React-managed).
adapters.vue: @absoluteui/vue/fieldset: AuiFieldset component (renders the fieldset; the default slot stays Vue-managed).
